summary: The speech bubble now sits clearly above the speaker's name tag in the author's screenshot, and the text is crisp and legible; the fix is a one-constant change with no frame-time cost. The 'clamp tags to the viewport' half of the todo was not done, and I could not take a live screenshot myself.

findings.what: The todo also asked to clamp name tags to the viewport. That was not implemented: in the author's own screenshot the 'Mars' tag is cut off at the right edge of the 3D view ('Mars' at x~830-864). The todo was marked done anyway.
findings.where: dev/NeverendingGame/src/scenery.jl:sync_text! (tags are positioned only by world point + fixed pixel offset)
findings.suggestion: Project tag points to pixel space and clamp x to [w/2, width - w/2] (or fade tags at the edge), or reopen the clamp part as its own todo.

findings.what: The overlap fix is a fixed 44 px offset that assumes the tag height (16 + 18 px font + padding). Changing the nametag font size or showing a multi-line speech will bring the overlap back. Tag and speech are anchored at different points (height*1.02 vs height) so the gap is not derived from either.
findings.suggestion: Name the constants (TAG_OFFSET, TAG_FONT) and compute the speech offset from them.

findings.what: I could not verify in the live game. NeverendingGame fails to load in my review session (package JSON not installed in the jail depot), so live_screenshot and live_status were unavailable. I judged from text-v6-speech.png, scenery.jl and state/perf.json. perf.json shows frame median 1.25 ms, p95 2.0 ms, sync 0.97 ms, so the 33 ms budget has a large margin. Only a single speaker was shown; a crowded scene with several bubbles was not tested. The 'Next on the list' panel in that screenshot still lists the overlap todo, so it was captured before the todo was closed.
findings.suggestion: Add a screenshot with two or more creatures talking close together.

findings.what: Speech is still plain text with a glow and no background; on the dark shadowed grass it reads well, but over bright sky or the pale rocks contrast is untested. The pill background remains a separate open todo.
findings.suggestion: Test on a bright background when doing the pill todo.
